title: Question about pixel art? Does it takes to long?

posts.author: NaMosca
posts.body: Hey. It took me 2hours and 15 minutes to do 2 RTP rpg maker XP sprites, so I have this doubt. Basically I recolored the cape and add it in other character and use the head of one character in another. So the question is: Was I too slow?

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
NaMosca said:
Was I too slow?
Click to expand...
thats up to you. It takes you however long it takes for you to work on it, and people generally get faster the more they do something. The engine isnt going to do something different because of how long you spent making something

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: Sounds to me you would've probably been able to just use the included character generator to get what you want.

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body: i dont think xp had a character generator. iirc its only ace and mv/z

posts.author: MiguelRPG
posts.body:
It wasn't slow, but as you progress and get used to the tools, your speed improves.
You'll also find ready-made resources, such as sprites to generate new characters, by assembling them instead of extracting them.
About the character generator for XP, I think there are sprites to make in the MV generator. But I found this generator here:
Sprite Creator 3 by SpriteCreator
Dress up a character. Save animated sprite sheet.
spritecreator.itch.io
Sprite Creator 3 (Finished) XP & VX
Current project status: 3-28-2014NEW Videos! Remove/Replace the built in images and how to add your own custom images.http://bit.ly/1tWueDG
opengameart.org
